T-B: a call to place is answered in its thread, by another member, with a written join that commits and gives no reason: {el}'s pair, with the bare join its mechanism names (G44); a specification
T-R: a call to place is answered in its thread, by another member, with a written join that gives an account of why the member joins, a ground or a motive (G44 reading 3): {el}'s pair, a join with a reason, which the census counts apart; a specification
T-O: a call to place is answered in its thread, by another member, with a written report of the member's own part done (G44 reading 2): {el}'s pair through P15's other forms; a specification
PROP: the answer assents to or takes up a proposal that calls no one to place (a design change, a plan's detail, a site, a neighbour's proposal or an errand), which P15's range holds with P02, P04 or P08; {el}'s first part, a call to place, is not shown (G44), and the census counts the line as a proposal answered
START: the join answers a start told in the present tense, or a report of where work goes on (R01 or P03), not a call, and no coded call from another member stands above it (G44 reading 1); {el}'s pair is not shown, and the census counts the line as a start joined
UNC: the answer replies to a post that carries no code, with no coded call from another member above it, so the pair cannot be read in the coded record, which is where {el}'s bound reads the form (G44 reading 4); the census counts the line as an uncoded first part
AFTER: the call and its answer concern a successor canvas after hour 73, which is carrying on (P13), not {el}'s pair on this canvas (G44 reading 5)
CALL: the call gets no written P15 answer in the line, only a remark, a wish or a report of others' work, which is the case {el}'s bound names (most calls get no written reply); the census counts the line as call only
REF: the call gets only a dispreferred answer, a refusal or a counter-direction with a reason, which is not P15 (G28) and is the other half of {el}'s mechanism; the census counts the line apart
PLEDGE: the join answers an explanation, not a call, and no call stands in the line: a pledge that answers no call, the failure clause's first half (G44), which the census counts as pledge only
